headline: Permanent Representative to UN caught weaponising water cooler conversation by citing global geopolitical instability as reason for not refilling the jug
body: The senior diplomat reportedly informed colleagues that the 'geopolitical abyss' prevented him from engaging in the logistical labor of replacing the empty 20-liter bottle. He instead delivered a ten-minute briefing on the existential threat posed by empty dispensers to collective workplace security.
caption: When the office supply chain is a matter of international security. #UN #Diplomacy #OfficeLife #Geopolitics (satire)
igHook: Tag the colleague who uses 'global instability' as an excuse for every single household chore.
imagePrompt: A close-up shot of an empty office water cooler dispenser with a blue plastic bottle sitting upside down, captured in a sterile, brightly lit corporate hallway.

sourceHeadline.title: ‘World on edge of abyss today, seeing weaponisation of everything’: Jaishankar at UN | India News
